description: Deterministic ensemble of two complementary population readouts: a time-resolved ridge model using several within-trial acausal Gaussian scales and temporal derivatives, and a trial-level kernel ridge model mapping complete held-in trajectories to complete held-out trajectories. Held-out targets are lightly smoothed only within trial to estimate conditional rates. Five-fold trial-level cross-validation selects ridge regularization and a nonnegative simplex blend by Poisson deviance; out-of-fold predictions also provide shrunk per-neuron calibration. Predictions are clipped to finite, nonnegative counts per 20 ms bin.
